label: Characterize finite certificates excluding all supplierless ancestors
meaning: A given audit excludes all supplierless ancestors exactly when it covers the actual cone and that cone has no supplierless member. Deleting incoming edges at an unaudited ancestor preserves a path from it by discarding any prefix that returns to it. Full coverage of a finite cone supplies the converse certificate. An acyclic actual cone therefore admits no finite negative certificate. The deletion alternatives are part of the unrestricted information model.
